text: Your Shorts get zero views for three reasons.
Mistake one: a slow start. Viewers decide in one second.
Fix: open on your most shocking frame.
Mistake two: tiny captions nobody can read.
Fix: big words, three at a time.
Mistake three: posting once, then quitting.
Fix: post every day for thirty days.
That's how my channel hit 9.2M views in 28 days.
Comment GROW and I'll send you my posting plan.
